In a galaxy far from Gaea, the dust forming upon Kos existence flows from one of many tears in the fabric of reality. Here the dust coalesces to form strange and fantastic shapes defying perception before fragmenting into stars, rocks, and other cosmic oddities. At this junction of change and the fabric of reality, the First Light and its counterpart steal a handful of dust. With it, the Light molds it delicately until a round shell as thick as a finger is formed. The First Light smiles, placing his bright glowing palm upon the ball dyed blue with the light of his halo. The heatwave from it melts a nearby ice planetoid. When he lifts his hand, the ball's once gray surface is left with a matching gold form imprinted upon it.

"Are you ready?" He asks

"Are you really sure this will work? You're not him, Primus."

"I'm as close as it gets" The first light rebuts, digging into her shoulder with his pale, radiating hand. With the other, he forms a finger, and into the yellowed hand print it stabs before the other Light can get in a word edgewise. As they touch the gold smears to a tarnished silver before melting completely and dragging them from our reality.

"What hell is this nightmare!" his companion shouts.

Primus grimaces, "That was excruciating, please tone it down. Assuming I was right, this is non-existence. Wow. I'm glad this worked, but we are never trying this again."

Shrieking in reply, "Are you telling me we now don't exist and can never get back?"

"Damn it, don't you ever listen? This is *my* non-existence, the opening is on the ball and the exit is right *here*. " He points at his forehead. With a cry, the frazled Light throws itself as Primus and vanishes upon contact.

" Left behind. Figures.", Primus grumbles before vanishing from his new empty space back before the cosmic birthing ground. Ashamed, the other Light sits faced away from the ball. Its eyes are dim even in the light of the nebula.

"Why are we here." The Light sighs. "We serve no purpose."

"Because existence simply is," The First Light replies.

"Well I'm sick of this. I just can't-"

"Wait," The First Light interjects quickly. "I feel something."

"Barking at the moon when there're this many is pointless, Primus".

"I'm telling you, something is stirring." The First Light's blank brows shine just slightly brighter.

"Then we're finding it; point." The other Light burst.

"You still didn't listen."

"What're you jabbering on about?"

The First Light smiled, "I have my own point of non-existence. While it may not be festooned with anything, it is mine." Taking up his counter's hand again, they watch the outside world zoom by in a blue tinge of broken spacetime law, only to promptly appear between a star and the more distant of two moons orbiting a verdant planet. The light from the sun shines faintly through Primus's blue ball and glances the edge of a moon. Primus gasps,

"Do you hear it?"

"What?"

"The Cacophony!?" he cries.

"I hear a faint whisper, and that's all." The other Light replies solemnly.

"That planet..." he whispers.
